name: Hey I just met you
source:
[i]Hey, I just met you,
and this is crazy.
But you're my colleague,
so dinner, maybe?[/i]

[From [url=https://jintii.itch.io/hey-i-just-met-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]嘿，我们才刚见面，
虽然听着有点疯癫。
既然你我是同事，
不如约顿晚饭见？[/i]

[摘自[url=https://jintii.itch.io/hey-i-just-met-you]itch.io[/url]]
